criteria.sufficiency: S1 confirms the evaluator contract binds a deterministic machine-executable pre-freeze validator over the actual candidate bundle; E1 shows a real complete bundle producing a machine-readable PASS through that validator; E2 shows it running against a real incomplete bundle. Together they establish the validator exists and consumes the actual bundle.

AC02 is a behavioural claim about the validator; E2 constructs a bundle whose required criterion/procedure reference has genuinely absent material and shows the validator returns FAIL for that reason - the direct falsification test.

AC03 constrains how the negative path is built; E2's decision rule requires the incomplete condition to be constructed in the bundle and forbids establishing the case from a pre-set integrityValidation FAIL, which is exactly the Spike 010b defect.
AC04 is the freeze-prevention claim; E3 shows a validator FAIL of the AC02/AC03 class blocking private freeze.
AC05 is the readiness-PASS-prevention claim; E3 shows the same FAIL preventing a valid readiness PASS for that evaluator revision.

E3 shows a failed preparation cannot reach canonical evaluation-prepared; S2 confirms the public authority half rejects a map without a passing readiness attestation, so the canonical event is unreachable.
AC07 is the positive path; E1 shows a structurally complete bundle passing the same validator and proceeding to freeze.

E4 exercises both traceability directions (dangling forward reference and orphaned procedure each FAIL); S1 confirms the contract requires bidirectional checking, guarding against a one-directional implementation.

E4 shows required files/support material checked against the actual bundle and freeze inventory; P5 confirms this cycle's own freeze inventory lists every depended-on file and every identity recomputes, establishing the inventory is the real check target.

E5 shows the readiness evidence mechanically produced from the validator result and bound to evaluator/inventory identity; A1 confirms the frozen map's attestation carries exactly that binding and no private content; S2 confirms the authority consumes only that structure.

S1 confirms the validator is bounded to structural properties; S2 confirms the authority never opens a private path or scores quality; A1 confirms the public projection exposes no grader logic; E5 exercises the accepted structural path.
E6 shows terminal result accounting derived from / checked against the frozen bundle; S1 confirms the contract makes prose non-authoritative for those counts.
AC13 explicitly demands regression coverage for the 13 of 13 while naming 14 procedures class; E6 is that scenario.

E7 shows a fully non-executable prepared evaluator passing the validator and freezing; S1 confirms the contract keeps non-executable evidence first-class and forbids the validator from forcing executable coverage.
